lessons.title: Film ve öyküye gerekçeli kişisel tepki ver
lessons.objective: Bir sahneyi kısaca aktar, duygunun ne zaman değiştiğini ve bunu hangi ayrıntının sağladığını açıkla.
lessons.situation: Bir film kulübünde aynı kısa filmi izleyen iki kişinin farklı tepkileri var.
lessons.bridge: Önce sahneyi bir cümlede ver. I was surprised by ile tepkini, because ile somut gerekçeyi söyle. At first ve by the end ile değişimi göster.

models.phrase: I was surprised by the ending because Mira left the key behind.
models.explanation: Surprised duyguyu yaşayanı, surprising etki yaratan şeyi niteler. By ile nedeni adlandır.

models.phrase: At first I felt sorry for Mira. By the end I was relieved that she had left.
models.explanation: At first ilk tepkiyi, by the end son bölümdeki tepkiyi işaretler. Relieved, bir kaygı ortadan kalktığında kullanılır.

concepts.label: Tepki ve etkiyi ayır
concepts.incorrect: I was surprising by the empty room.
concepts.correct: I was surprised by the empty room.
concepts.explanation: Kişinin tepkisi -ed; tepkiye yol açan şey -ing.
guided: I was ___ by the last scene. (surprised / surprising)
transfer: The children were ___ by the sudden noise. (frightened / frightening)
The ending of the radio play was ___. (moved / moving)
delayed: The audience looked ___ when the doors closed. (disappointed / disappointing)
The museum guide told a ___ story. (fascinated / fascinating)

concepts.label: Tepkiyi sahnedeki ayrıntıya bağla
concepts.incorrect: It was moving because it was nice.
concepts.correct: It was moving because Mira set a second place for someone who would never come.
concepts.explanation: Duygu sıfatını açıklamak için görülen ya da işitilen bir ayrıntı belirt.
guided: “I felt worried when the lights went out.” Hangi ayrıntı: lights went out / felt worried?
“The joke worked because he read the wrong letter.” Neden: wrong letter / joke worked?
transfer: “I was relieved when she found the child.” Neden: found the child / relieved?
“The scene confused me because both voices sounded alike.” Neden: voices sounded alike / confused?
delayed: “I lost interest when the same chase started again.” Neden: chase started again / lost interest?
“I felt sorry for him when nobody answered.” Ayrıntı: nobody answered / sorry?

word.example: I felt sorry for the boy at the gate.
word.usage: Feel sorry for birine empati duymaktır. I am sorry about bir olay için üzüntü bildirir.
collocations: feel sorry for the main character
recognize: “feel sorry for” burada ne anlama gelir?
Feel sorry for birine empati duymaktır. I am sorry about bir olay için üzüntü bildirir.
word.use: Bir öyküde yaptığını onaylamasan da üzüldüğün kişiyi anlat.

additionalWords.example: The final image stayed with me.
additionalWords.usage: Anı veya izlenimin sürmesi. Geçmişi stayed with me.
collocations: the line will stay with me
recognize: “stay with me” burada ne anlama gelir?
Anı veya izlenimin sürmesi. Geçmişi stayed with me.
additionalWords.use: Aklında kalan bir görüntünün somut özelliğini söyle.

writing.prompt: Gördüğün bir kısa film veya okuduğun bir öyküden 80–110 sözcüklük kulüp mesajı yaz. Önceki ve sonraki tepkini bir sahneyle gerekçelendir.
writing.sample: At first I was puzzled by the old man at the station. He kept placing his umbrella on an empty seat. I thought he was afraid someone might sit too close. Then the guard brought him a cup and asked about his brother. I realised the umbrella had belonged to his brother. The station had been their meeting place. By the end I felt sorry for the man. The empty seat stayed with me because the film let us notice his loss before anyone explained it.
writing.revision: İki tepkiyi ayır. İkinci tepkiyi doğuran işitsel ya da görsel ayrıntıyı ekle.
criteria: İlk ve sonraki yorum arasında değişim görünür.

input.text: Film club note. When Mira takes the picture off the wall, we see an empty frame on the table. I expected her to hang a new photo. Instead, she wrapped the old one in a clean cloth. That small action stayed with me, even after the credits. She had left the house, but she was not leaving everything behind.
reading: wrapped the old one in a clean cloth
input.transcript: Jo: At first I felt sorry for Mira. Everyone seemed to be telling her what to do. Pat: I liked the moment when she put the kettle on. She was finally doing something at her own pace. Jo: I was relieved when she did not answer the last call. The room was quiet for the first time.
input.preparation: Kimin hangi anda fikrinin değiştiğini ayır.
detail: did not answer the last call

retry.text: The first letter made me laugh, but the second felt cruel. By then I knew who had written both of them.
retry.transcript: I was confused by the last picture. Then I heard the same whistle as in the opening scene. I thought the boy might have returned.
retry.preparation: Anlatıcının duyduğu ile çıkardığı sonucu ayır.

lessons.readingPurpose: Duygu, kanıt ve tahmin için ayrı not al.
lessons.readingUse: Kendi yorumunu yaz ve başka bir yoruma açık bir ayrıntı seç.
lessons.listeningUse: Arkadaşına bir konuşmacının yorumunu gerekçesiyle aktar.
lessons.speaking: Bir öykü kapanışına tepki ver. Partner başka bir yorumu savunursa onun seçtiği ayrıntıyı geri söyle, ardından kendi kanıtını sun.

recovery.main: Pat’in seçtiği günlük sesi veya eylemi dinle.
recovery.detail: Jo relieved dedikten sonra hangi yan tümce geliyor?

grammarStrands: tepki sıfatlarında -ed/-ing ve by ile neden
